_comment: Importable n8n nodes for the read-only verify-workspace-account webhook used by the HRIS 'Verify' button. Paste into the HRIS Onboarding Automation workflow (n8n: select canvas > Ctrl/Cmd+V, or 'Import from clipboard'). It looks up the Google Workspace user by work_email via the Directory API and responds { exists: true|false }. It NEVER creates anything. Make sure the workflow is ACTIVE so the production webhook registers.
